tools.Name: Claude Code
tools.Description: An agentic coding tool that lives in the terminal, capable of understanding codebases and assisting with tasks.
tools.Use_Case: Automating routine development tasks, code explanation, and Git workflow management through natural language.

tools.Name: SkillSpector
tools.Description: A security scanner designed to detect vulnerabilities and malicious patterns in AI agent skills.
tools.Use_Case: Scanning AI agent skills (e.g., MCP) for risks like prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain vulnerabilities before installation.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully-local, open-source alternative to commercial voice synthesis platforms.
tools.Use_Case: Performing voice cloning, video dubbing, transcription, and audiobook creation while maintaining data privacy on local hardware.
